summary_en: ¥510M acquisition of 508 shares of Metal Creation (50.8% post-acquisition ownership). Method: stock exchange at 1:1,700 ratio (Japan Creative Platform issues 836,400 treasury shares to Metal Creation shareholders). Effective 2 October 2026. Metal Creation manufactures paperboard machinery and industrial parts; both parties share focus on paper products.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of shares in Metal Creation Co., Ltd. and complete subsidiary status through simplified stock exchange
translation_en_brief: Japan Creative Platform Group has acquired 508 shares of Metal Creation Co., Ltd. (representing 50.8% post-acquisition ownership) for ¥510 million (including ¥2 million in transaction costs). The acquisition was completed on 17 August 2026 via share purchase agreement. A simplified stock exchange has been entered into the same day to make Metal Creation a wholly owned subsidiary. Under the exchange, Metal Creation shareholders will receive 1,700 shares of Japan Creative Platform for every 1 Metal Creation share held; Japan Creative Platform will issue 836,400 treasury shares (no new issuance). The exchange is scheduled to become effective 2 October 2026, subject to Metal Creation shareholder approval at a special meeting (26 September 2026). Japan Creative Platform qualifies for simplified procedures (no shareholder vote required) because Metal Creation's prior-year assets are less than 10% of Japan Creative Platform's prior-year equity, and Metal Creation's prior-year revenue is less than 3% of Japan Creative Platform's prior-year revenue; however, Metal Creation qualifies as a specified subsidiary due to capital size. Metal Creation manufactures paperboard machinery (combined-board machines, automated box-making machines, cover-gluing machines) and industrial components; Japan Creative Platform operates creative services and solutions. Both parties cite shared focus on paper products and complementary enterprise values.
